verdict.rationale: Flagsmith is open-source and self-hostable, giving users full control of their underlying database, and the Admin API/CLI let you programmatically read and manage 'anything in the dashboard' (flags, segments, identities, projects), which supports data portability. However, there is no documented one-click 'export all data' feature, no stated export file format (CSV/JSON), and no migration/backup guide for leaving a hosted instance. Missing for 10: explicit bulk data-export tooling, documented open export format, and a documented process for migrating off Flagsmith Cloud to self-hosted or another platform.
